Todd Beamer- 32,  was an account manager with Oracle. He was on United flight# 93.  Todd was the father of two boys and his wife, Lisa was pregnant at the time of his death, giving birth 4 months later.He played baseball at Fresno State before transferring to Wheaton Collage where he met Lisa. He was talking with an operator for the last 13 minutes of the flight. Thumbnail image of Vampire Killing Kit, 19th century, on display in the Gun Room within the Hunting Gallery at the Royal Armouries Museum, Leeds in December 2012.  The kit contains a velvet-lined mahogany case with silver cruciform lock plate and paper label bearing a handwritten psalm. Contains a box-lock percussion pocket pistol and iron bullet mould, both c.1850, a gilt metal and mahogany crucifix, a rosary, four oak 'stakes', a wooden mallet, a book of commom prayer dated 1857, a piece of cloth and three bottles containing 'consecrated earth', 'garlic paste' and 'holy water'.

Inova Team -Modern Cotton Handmade Pillows - Set of 3 - Rest your head close to home on the North/Central America pillow or drift off to far away lands with the Asia/Australia and Africa/Europe versions. Either way, you can rest assured that these bright and cheery pillows help the greater good by providing fair wages and development opportunities for artisans in South West India. Pillow cases are made of cotton and decoration is applied using Batik, a traditional Indian art to create patterns on fabric. Set of three pillows.
